mapper.insert: INSERT INTO overdue_blacklist (user_id, reason, overdue_level, related_repayment_id, status, effective_at, expire_at, operator_name) SELECT #{userId}, #{reason}, #{overdueLevel}, #{relatedRepaymentId}, 'active', COALESCE(#{effectiveAt}, NOW()), #{expireAt}, #{operatorName} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM overdue_blacklist WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active' AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at > NOW()) )
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM overdue_blacklist WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active' AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at > NOW())
SELECT * FROM overdue_blacklist WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active' AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at > NOW()) ORDER BY effective_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE overdue_blacklist SET status = 'released', released_at = NOW(), release_reason = #{reason}, operator_name = COALESCE(#{operatorName}, operator_name) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active' AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at > NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM overdue_blacklist WHERE status = 'active' AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at > NOW()) ORDER BY effective_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM overdue_blacklist WHERE status = 'active' AND (expire_at IS NULL OR expire_at > NOW())
